# Card

Card. Groups content inside a page. Whether it has a shadow is a scheme decision (elevation.roles, elevation.definition): --card-shadow is "no shadow" in schemes that separate with lines. Reads only component keys: --card-\*.

See it in [Storybook](http://localhost:6006) under Components / Card, in every theme.

## Component keys

The CSS variable is the key with `/` replaced by `-`.

| Key | What it controls | Reads | light | dark |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `card/background` | Card fill. | `color.surface.default` | #FFFFFF | #161B23 |
| `card/border` | Card border. | `color.border.default` | #DDE2EA | #262D38 |
| `card/radius` | Card corner radius. | `radius.container` | 0.375rem (6px) | 0.375rem (6px) |
| `card/padding` | Padding inside a card. | `space.inset.container` | 1rem (16px) | 1rem (16px) |
| `card/shadow` | Card shadow. | `elevation.card` | 0px 0px 0px 0px #00000000 | 0px 0px 0px 0px #00000000 |

## When to use it

| Situation | Use | Not | Why |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Between page sections | space.gap.section and a hairline | A card around every section | Lines separate without taking room from the data. |
